title: Warm Crumbly Indian Naan Bakery-Style Biryani
description: A traditional Indian dish featuring the authentic flavors of Bengal, with the warmth of spices and the crunch of fresh naan.
instructions: Preheat a tandoor or a conventional oven to 400°F (200°C).
Roll out the naan dough into thin circles, about 1/8 inch thick.
Heat the ghee in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the clove powder and cardamom powder to the skillet and stir well.
Add the chopped cilantro and heavy cream to the skillet and stir well.
Add the day-old rice to the skillet and stir well to combine with the spices and cream.
Place the rolled out naan dough on top of the rice mixture, allowing the edges to overlap slightly.
Brush the top of the naan dough with the remaining ghee and sprinkle with salt.
Place the tandoor or skillet in the preheated oven and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the naan is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the naan from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
